prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: wide lesson illustration. Wide grid exactly six small vignettes, three across two rows: worker painting a crosswalk; library doors opening with book shelves visible; rubbish collection truck; modest fire station with parked fire engine; park slide; street lamp. No signs or text. Style: warm everyday watercolor and fine ink educational illustration on ivory paper, accessible civic spaces, diverse ordinary people of varied ages in everyday clothing; no national flags, seals, eagles, logos, readable words, numbers, labels or watermarks. Format: wide landscape 3:2. Warm paper texture, restrained muted colors and clear fine ink contours. Every person has a coherent hairstyle and exactly two naturally connected arms with clear shoulder-elbow-wrist continuity. Natural unstrained hands; keep poses simple and seated hands in laps if practical. In voting scenes show only an adult hand and plain box. Any paper contains no letters, names, signatures or numbers: only blank space or blank straight ruled lines when a clipboard is requested. No insignia or pictographic emblems. Preserve exact number and arrangement of panels where specified.
